content_sections.heading: About Tirupathur DHS Staff Nurse
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Tirupathur, works under the Medical and Public Welfare Department of Tirupathur district in Tamil Nadu. Its District Health Office is at Chairman Lakshmanan Street, opposite the Municipality Office, Tirupathur. The 54 Staff Nurse posts in this recruitment serve the CEmONC centres of Government Hospitals in the district, including their SNCU and PICU units.

content_sections.heading: Tirupathur DHS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: As of 21 November 2026, the application window is open. The press release does not print its own date of issue.

content_sections.heading: Tirupathur DHS Staff Nurse Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Tirupathur, is filling a total of 54 contract Staff Nurse posts. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 54 posts. It asks applicants to enclose a caste certificate and, where applicable, a priority certificate for Differently abled, Transgender or Destitute Widow candidates.

rows.posting: Government Hospital – CEmONC centres (including SNCU and PICU), Tirupathur district

content_sections.heading: Tirupathur DHS Staff Nurse Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from eligible nurses and names the nursing course as B.Sc Nursing / GNM. Other requirements printed in the notice: Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration certificate. 10th and 12th standard mark sheets. Residence proof: Aadhaar card, Voter ID card or Family card. Caste certificate. Priority certificate for Differently abled, Transgender or Destitute Widow candidates, where applicable. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility for the Staff Nurse post.

rows.qualification_required: Nursing course (B.Sc Nursing / GNM), with mark sheets of all years of the course

content_sections.heading: Tirupathur DHS Staff Nurse Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The posts are filled purely temporarily on contract basis through the District Health Society. The notice does not mention any allowance in addition to the Rs.21,000 monthly pay.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Tirupathur DHS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the Tirupathur district website, https://tirupathur.nic.in . Fill in the application form completely. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below. Send the application to: District Health Officer, District Health Office, Chairman Lakshmanan Street, Opposite Municipality Office, Tirupathur, 635601. Submit it in person or by post between 20.11.2026 and 5.00 PM on 04.12.2026. 10th standard mark sheet. 12th standard mark sheet. Nursing course (B.Sc Nursing / GNM) mark sheets of all years. Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration certificate. Residence proof (Aadhaar card / Voter ID card / Family card). Caste certificate. Priority certificate (Differently abled, Transgender, Destitute Widow), where applicable. All copies must be self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Tirupathur DHS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications submitted for the earlier Staff Nurse notification are not valid for these 54 posts. Candidates who applied earlier must submit a new application for these posts. The appointment is purely temporary and on contract basis.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Tirupathur DHS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 54 newly created contract Staff Nurse posts in Government Hospital – CEmONC centres (including SNCU and PICU) of Tirupathur district.

faq.question: Q2. When do applications start for the Tirupathur Staff Nurse posts?
Q3. What is the last date to apply for Tirupathur DHS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted until 5.00 PM on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Tirupathur Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: The notice names the nursing course as B.Sc Nursing / GNM and asks for mark sheets of all years along with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration certificate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Tirupathur DHS contract Staff Nurse?

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Tirupathur DHS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://tirupathur.nic.in and send it with self-attested documents to the District Health Officer, District Health Office, Chairman Lakshmanan Street, Opposite Municipality Office, Tirupathur, 635601, in person or by post.

faq.question: Q7. I applied for the earlier Staff Nurse notification. Do I need to apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications submitted for the earlier Staff Nurse notification are not valid for these posts, so a fresh application must be submitted.

faq.answer: No. The posts are filled purely temporarily on contract basis through the District Health Society.
